The four kinds the debugger's `CAPTURE` records, from the sound guest (`tests/guest/sound.asm`),
headless, each turned on at a stop and off at the stop `run_for` reached.

two-frames.wav     the mixer over two retraces: 16-bit stereo at 48000 Hz, not silent (the
                   guest's 1 kHz square from the PIT, and its OPL voice)
two-frames.avi     the screen over the same two retraces, a finished ZMBV capture of two frames
eight-frames.dro   the OPL2 over eight retraces, DRO 2.0: the register state the writer dumps
                   at its first event (the guest's nonzero registers, by register number, the
                   voice keyed off), then that event, B0h keyed on again at the BIOS tick
eight-frames.mid   the MIDI bytes over the same eight retraces: middle C's note-off (a note-on of
                   velocity 0), then its note-on a BIOS tick later
